body.message:
Thank you for your explanation.

I understand that the apartment is operated as a holiday home. However, since I am planning to stay for 8 months, I would need some certainty regarding the rental cost. Would it be possible to agree on and guarantee the same monthly rate for the entire 8-month period, even if the booking is divided into separate blocks?

I would be happy to visit the apartment, but before moving forward, I would like to know whether the rate can remain fixed for the full duration of my stay.
